stance_rationale: The package is a design protocol, not an auditable risk package: covariance.parquet, weights.csv, alpha_scores.parquet, tail_risk.json, stress matrix, and crowding outputs are absent, and the qepm/stage_artifacts/WT_WT-D20260517_004 directory does not exist. Revise before finalization by either downgrading all empirical language to protocol-only or producing the required Forge artifacts for RF-R1~RF-R9 verification.

regime_sigma_audit.comment: Package estimates CRISIS <= 10 and CAUTION 10-20 but provides no measured regime_n, bootstrap CI, transition matrix, or realized switch-rate gap.

crowding_audit.family_saturation_check: Not measured. Package also loosens role-prompt crowding guidance by using TDC alarm 0.40 vs recommended <0.30 and HHI alarm 0.20 vs recommended <=0.10.

pit_c1_c15_audit.evidence: No covariance.parquet, alpha_scores.parquet, weights.csv, or rolling per-sig_date outputs exist at the requested qepm artifact path.
t-1 beta and p_bad timing are specified, but no executable lineage or realized schedule verifies absence of same-period circularity.
Fundamental lag rules are textual only; no factor panel or Usable_Date lineage is available.
vol_lag/dd_lag/regime lag handling is design-level only; no implementation or audit artifact exists.
KR_TOP500_LIQ1E8 ranking and 2e8 holdings extraction are specified, but no t-1 liquidity schedule or weights.csv exists.
External time-series lag handling is not demonstrated in risk artifacts.
Factor return calculation PIT cannot be checked without generated factor returns or covariance inputs.
Usable_Date <= sig_date is promised but not evidenced.
load_month_factors_v2() is mandated, but no code lineage proves Factor DB access avoided direct parquet loads.

critical_concerns.description: Requested empirical artifacts are absent: weights.csv is missing, qepm/stage_artifacts/WT_WT-D20260517_004 does not exist, and covariance.parquet/alpha_scores.parquet cannot be inspected for time-series schedule, PSD, min eigenvalue, or cond <= 100.

Sigma selection is forecast-only: median cond=55, PSD, selected counts, and method_shopping results are labeled priors, while shrinkage intensity delta, delta=1 detection, min eigenvalues, and factor_coverage_r2 are unavailable.

The risk design depends on unresolved hard-constraint exceptions: union max_names=40, KR_TOP500_LIQ1E8 ranking, 1e8 ranking liquidity, and 25bps comp cost conflict with base max_names=20, KOSPI200 union KOSDAQ150, 2e8 liquidity, and 15bps cost unless governor approval is explicit.

The NAV cross-covariance gate is statistically fragile: only 52 OOS months are proposed, the stated 95% correlation CI half-width is about 0.27 versus a 0.30 hard threshold, and beta-neutralized residual NAV remains unproven as investable and costed.
Tail, crowding, and stress checks are not measurable: no CVaR/CDaR/Hill/VaR99/ES99/EVT outputs, no 32-cell stress matrix, no TDC/HHI/style correlation, and no family saturation results are present.

The package's red_flag_check mapping is incomplete or inconsistent with the role prompt: RF-R7 is missing, RF-R2 text still references cond>500 rather than cond>100, RF-R4 is renamed to market_down_5, and RF-R6 is mapped to CVaR while the role prompt defines Hill alpha <1.0.

No Silent Override is incomplete for the risk cycle: codex_round_completed=false, risk_challenge_note is absent, risk_package final and optimizer context are absent, and challenge_flags=[] despite unresolved RF-R1~RF-R9 evidence gaps.

Regime-conditional risk is acknowledged as thin-sample but not resolved: CRISIS <=10 and CAUTION 10-20 are expected, yet no measured bootstrap CI, pooled fallback, or switch-rate estimated-vs-realized diagnostic is provided.

supporting_arguments: The draft correctly uses condition_number rather than return performance as the stated sigma selection objective.
The design explicitly separates admission metrics from diagnostic subset sigma and mandates bootstrap CI for thin regimes.
The alpha-side correction of the cross-sleeve correlation prior to 0.3-0.6 is more honest than the earlier by-construction <=0.3 claim.
unresolved_disputes: Whether discovery_design_phase_a exempts this package from the role prompt's covariance.parquet and risk artifact verification requirements.
Whether max_names union 40 and KR_TOP500_LIQ1E8 are authorized before governor approval.
Whether beta-neutralized residual NAV is an executable sleeve return after costs, leverage, cash drag, and turnover are included.
Whether 52 OOS months can support a 0.30 correlation gate when the CI width is nearly the same size as the gate.
weakest_assumption: The single weakest sigma assumption is that rolling 60m Ledoit-Wolf Oracle on N<=20 comp holdings will consistently deliver PSD cond<=100 with usable information content, even though no covariance.parquet, shrinkage delta, min eigenvalue series, or factor_coverage_r2 exists.
rebuttal_required: Produce covariance.parquet with per-sig_date shape, min_eigenvalue, condition_number, shrinkage_intensity, estimator_selected, and RF-R2/RF-R9 pass flags.
Produce weights.csv and alpha_scores.parquet so schedule, universe, liquidity, and PIT checks can be replayed.
Provide empirical method_shopping_log replacing design_forecast counts with measured candidate results.
Generate tail_risk.json with CVaR_95, CDaR_95, Hill alpha, VaR_99, ES_99, EVT-GPD, and stress_8 results.
Generate crowding outputs for TDC vs PG2, HHI, style correlation, family saturation L-219, and crowding HHI thresholds.
Record formal approval or rejection of the max_names=40, KR_TOP500_LIQ1E8, and 25bps cost exceptions.
Submit risk_challenge_note.md and complete the risk Codex round before final risk_package.json.

risk_specific_questions: What is the per-sig_date Ledoit-Wolf shrinkage delta distribution, and do any months hit delta=1.0 full shrinkage?
If CRISIS n<=10 makes regime metrics unavailable, what exact pooled fallback does the optimizer consume?
Why is TDC alarm set at 0.40 when the role prompt recommends <0.30 versus PG2 active?
